events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the fatal shooting of influential rapper Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: On this day in 1996, the music world lost a legend. We remember Tupac Shakur and his incredible impact on hip-hop and culture.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The anniversary of the passing of rock icon Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day. His guitar mastery continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Abbey Road's Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Turns 57
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher is 54 today! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: Imagine Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Release Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-one years ago, John Lennon's powerful message of peace, 'Imagine', was released as a single in the UK. Its relevance endures.

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple changed how we listen to music forever. What was on your first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the UK release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's James Bond Day! We're celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit UK screens.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy genius.

events.title: The White Album's Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unveiled their sprawling 'White Album'. A truly diverse and influential record. What's your top track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary.

events.title: Rubber Soul's Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: The anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we remember John Lennon, who was tragically taken from us. His legacy of peace and music lives on.
